header_subtitle.en: Construction Safety Monitoring and Inspection Technologies
header_subtitle.zh: 施工安全監測與檢查技術

intro.en: Please complete your expert background and evaluate the maturity assessment tool. All background questions and rating questions are required; further comments are optional.
intro.zh: 請完成專家背景資料並評估成熟度模型工具。所有背景問題及評分題皆為必填，其他建議為選填。

label.en: Q1. What is your current role in the construction industry?
label.zh: 請問您目前在營建產業中是擔任什麼角色？

label.en: Q2. What is your highest degree of education?
Q3. How many years of experience do you have in the construction industry?
label.zh: 請問您目前在營建產業擁有多少年的工作/教學經驗？

label.en: Q4. How many years of experience do you have in construction safety management?
label.zh: 請問您目前在安全管理擁有多少年的工作/教學經驗？

label.en: Q5. How many years of experience do you have with smart technology in construction safety monitoring and inspection?
label.zh: 請問您在營建領域之智慧技術應用方面有多少年的經驗？

criteria.en: Indicators and sub-indicators are relevant to safety monitoring and inspection technology adoption readiness assessment tool
criteria.zh: 指標在智慧安全工地技術採用成熟度評估有相關

criteria.en: Indicators and sub-indicators cover all aspects of safety monitoring and inspection technology adoption readiness assessment tool
criteria.zh: 指標涵蓋智慧安全工地評估的所有方面

criteria.en: Indicators and sub-indicators are correctly assigned to their respective categories
criteria.zh: 各子指標已正確地分配至各自的大指標
子指標之間有明確的區別

criteria.en: The maturity levels sufficiently represent progression in the sub-indicators
criteria.zh: 成熟度等級反映各子指標的進展情況

criteria.en: There is no overlap detected between descriptions of maturity levels
criteria.zh: 成熟度等級之間有明確的區別

criteria.en: The documentations (i.e., assessment instructions) are easy to understand
criteria.zh: 評估說明內容淺顯易懂

criteria.en: Scoring scheme (maturity level from 1 to 5) is easy to use
criteria.zh: 成熟度等級從 1 到 5操作簡便

aspect.en: Ease of use of the tool

criteria.en: The assessment tool is easy to use
The tool is useful for assessing safety monitoring and inspection technology adoption readiness of your organization
criteria.zh: 工具有助於評估組織在安全監測與檢查技術方面的採用就緒度

criteria.en: The tool is practical for use in construction industry
criteria.zh: 工具在營造業中具有實用價值

comments_question.en: Do you have any other recommendations?
comments_question.zh: 請問您是否有其他建議？

incomplete_message.zh: 送出前請完成 5 題專家背景資料及 13 題評分問題。
